Marcus,

We're kicking off Acme Enterprise's security review for an upcoming procurement and need your SOC 2 Type II materials for the vendor checklist. Can you confirm the audit period covered by your most recent Type II? We typically need: 

- The full SOC 2 Type II report (or executive summary + bridge letter)
- A short statement on scope (which services/components are covered)
- Whether you can provide control-level evidence samples (redacted) and an evidence index
- Clarification on log/retention backfills for specific dates (we'll list exact ranges after you confirm audit period)

Transfer: we prefer a secure Drive link or S3 presigned URLs for artifacts. If you require an NDA or additional data handling agreement before sharing, please note that.

Timeline: ideally within 10 business days (by 2028-06-18). If that's not possible, please tell us what you can provide in a short package first (summary + bridge letter).

Thanks,

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then I attached a concise pack that should let procurement move forward.

Audit period we have available: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (Type II, report issued 2026-02-28).

What we can provide immediately (see attachments):
- redwood-soc2-ii-report-2025-summary.pdf (exec summary + auditor opinion)
- bridge-letter-draft-202806.docx (optional signed bridge letter that describes continuity of controls through 2026-05-31)
- evidence-index-sample.csv (sample index showing the kinds of artifacts we can share)

Scope summary (short): Redwood Inference's hosted API, control plane, customer data handling processes for hosted inference, and operational controls for dedicated/private deployments were in scope. The attached summary includes a one-paragraph scoping note you can copy into your questionnaire. If you need an expanded control mapping (e.g., mapping to specific SIG/CAIQ sections) we can generate that as a follow-on item.

Redaction and sharing: we typically redact PII/credentials and will provide redacted evidence samples. Transfer options: pre-signed S3 links (preferred for larger bundles) or a secure Drive folder. We can also deliver via our secure fileshare portal and provide short-lived access. No additional NDA is required for the report and bridge letter; for raw artifacts we may ask for a standard CISO-level data handling acknowledgement (I attached a one-paragraph template you can use).

One-line reply template for procurement (feel free to cut/paste):
"Attached: Redwood Inference — SOC 2 Type II (2025 audit period) executive summary and draft bridge letter. Full report and evidence index available via secure link upon acceptance of standard data-handling acknowledgement."

Next steps: please confirm: 1) preferred transfer method (Drive vs presigned S3), 2) whether you'd like the bridge letter signed and attached, and 3) any immediate date ranges for log/retention checks so we can scope the evidence pull.

Tracker: I've opened an internal ticket (REW-47219) so Kimberly (Legal) and Connor (Security Eng) can help with evidence pulls.

Best,

Hi Aisha — Kimberly from Legal here. Quick answers to your clarifying points and confirmation of next steps.

1) Scope: The Type II report specifically calls out the hosted inference API ("Inference Service") and the control activities around its data flow — we included a short scope paragraph in the attached PDF you can pull into procurement language. If you want a one-line cert, here's text you can use verbatim: 

"The Soc 2 Type II report covers Redwood Inference's hosted inference API and the operational controls for customer data processing in hosted and dedicated configurations."

2) Bridge letter and Q3 2026 windows: Our bridge letter is written to communicate reasonable assurance that controls remained materially unchanged through 2026-05-31. That does not technically extend the audit period but provides a documented assertion for your team. For Q3 2026 windows specifically (July–Sept 2026), the bridge letter won't cover those months. If Brightleaf needs attestation for those exact windows, we can: 
- Provide sampled operational evidence for the requested date ranges (process logs, configuration snapshots) under our standard evidence-sharing process, or
- Arrange an auditor-led extension (this takes longer — we'd need to scope with Brightleaf).

3) Artifacts: Our evidence index includes both process-level artifacts and selected configuration snapshots (network/host-level) when relevant; we redact customer-identifying data and credentials. For your auditors, we can include a single sanitized network config snapshot as a sample.

Next steps:
- Confirm preferred transfer (you said Drive or presigned S3). We'll upload to presigned S3 by default unless you ask for Drive.
- We'll send the signed bridge letter (DocuSign) if you confirm you want it executed.
- For Q3 2026 log samples, please send the exact date ranges you need; Connor will confirm feasibility and expected turnaround.

I've assigned our internal ticket REW-47219 to Connor for the evidence pull. Marcus will continue to coordinate the report/bridge attachments.

Best regards,
